references.text: Jesus confirms that Lazarus has been dead for four days, emphasizing that the body is already decaying—a detail also mentioned in [ref:John 11:39|John 11:39] when he commands the stone to be removed.
When Jesus calls out to the one who has lain in the tomb for four days, the miracle prepared in [ref:John 11:43-44|John 11:43-44] is performed, where the dead man comes out bound.
Martha expresses her belief that Jesus could have prevented death if he had been present earlier, which contrasts with his actual arrival four days later in [ref:John 11:21-22|John 11:21-22].
